request_json.description: optional: 1-128 of A-Z a-z 0-9 | : . _ - (defaults to the idempotency key)

script.code:
SELECT DATE_FORMAT(n.t, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS db_now,
       CAST(j.id AS CHAR) AS id,
       j.idempotency_key,
       j.job_status,
       j.payload_hash,
       j.confirmation_hash,
       j.progress_message,
       j.row_version,
       CAST(j.gd_id AS CHAR) AS gd_id,
       j.gd_no,
       j.is_deleted
  FROM (SELECT NOW(3) AS t) n
  LEFT JOIN gd_async_job j
    ON j.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_EluyWNR5.data.tenantId}}'
   AND j.organization_id = '{{node:code_node_EluyWNR5.data.organizationId}}'
   AND j.idempotency_key = '{{node:code_node_EluyWNR5.data.idempotencyKey}}'

script.code:
SELECT CAST(j.id AS CHAR) AS job_id,
       j.job_status,
       j.source_so_no
  FROM gd_async_job j
 WHERE j.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_EluyWNR5.data.tenantId}}'
   AND j.organization_id = '{{node:code_node_EluyWNR5.data.organizationId}}'
   AND j.command = 'CREATE_GD_FROM_FORM'
   AND j.is_deleted = 0
   AND j.job_status IN ('QUEUED', 'VALIDATING', 'CALCULATING', 'READY_TO_COMMIT', 'COMMITTING_GD', 'RECONCILING_GD', 'REQUIRES_REVIEW')
   AND j.idempotency_key <> '{{node:code_node_EluyWNR5.data.idempotencyKey}}'
   AND {{node:code_node_GSsoPlan.data.soLikeSql}}
 ORDER BY j.id
 LIMIT 5

script.code:
SELECT 'SETUP' AS kind, CAST(ps.id AS CHAR) AS id, COALESCE(CAST(ps.picking_mode AS CHAR), '') AS f1, '' AS f2, '' AS f3, '' AS f4, '' AS f5
  FROM (SELECT p.id, p.picking_mode
          FROM picking_setup p
         WHERE p.organization_id = '{{node:code_node_GSfitPlan.data.orgSql}}'
   AND p.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_GSfitPlan.data.tenantSql}}'
           AND p.is_deleted = 0
         ORDER BY p.id
         LIMIT 1) ps
UNION ALL
SELECT 'ITEM' AS kind, CAST(i.id AS CHAR) AS id,
       COALESCE(CAST(i.stock_control AS CHAR), '') AS f1,
       COALESCE(CAST(i.material_costing_method AS CHAR), '') AS f2,
       COALESCE(CAST(i.item_batch_management AS CHAR), '') AS f3,
       COALESCE(CAST(i.serial_number_management AS CHAR), '') AS f4,
       COALESCE(CAST(i.purchase_unit_price AS CHAR), '') AS f5
  FROM item i
 WHERE i.organization_id = '{{node:code_node_GSfitPlan.data.orgSql}}'
   AND i.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_GSfitPlan.data.tenantSql}}'
   AND i.is_deleted = 0
   AND i.id IN ({{node:code_node_GSfitPlan.data.materialIdsSql}})
UNION ALL
SELECT 'HU' AS kind, CAST(hi.material_id AS CHAR) AS id, '' AS f1, '' AS f2, '' AS f3, '' AS f4, '' AS f5
  FROM handling_unit h
  JOIN handling_unit_atu7sreg_sub hi
    ON hi.handling_unit_id = h.id
   AND hi.is_deleted = 0
 WHERE h.organization_id = '{{node:code_node_GSfitPlan.data.orgSql}}'
   AND h.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_GSfitPlan.data.tenantSql}}'
   AND h.plant_id = {{node:code_node_GSfitPlan.data.plantSql}}
   AND h.is_deleted = 0
   AND (h.packing_id IS NULL OR h.packing_id = '')
   AND hi.material_id IN ({{node:code_node_GSfitPlan.data.autoMaterialIdsSql}})
 GROUP BY hi.material_id
UNION ALL
SELECT 'PEND' AS kind, CAST(r.parent_line_id AS CHAR) AS id, '' AS f1, '' AS f2, '' AS f3, '' AS f4, '' AS f5
  FROM on_reserved_gd r
 WHERE r.organization_id = '{{node:code_node_GSfitPlan.data.orgSql}}'
   AND r.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_GSfitPlan.data.tenantSql}}'
   AND r.plant_id = {{node:code_node_GSfitPlan.data.plantSql}}
   AND r.is_deleted = 0
   AND r.status = 'Pending'
   AND r.parent_line_id IN ({{node:code_node_GSfitPlan.data.soLineIdsSql}})
 GROUP BY r.parent_line_id
